security_findings.summary: Plaintext HTTP Basic Auth and NTRIP v1 SOURCE <password> transmit credentials without TLS encryption.
Static in-memory CredentialStore holds plaintext env-var passwords with no hashing, rotation, revocation, expiration, or per-mountpoint ACLs; apps/api has zero authentication.
security_findings.current_lab_mitigation: Ephemeral/local test credentials only; .env excluded by .gitignore.

security_findings.summary: LocalNtripCaster._accept_loop() spawns a new thread per accepted TCP socket before authentication; max_clients is enforced post-auth with no pre-auth cap or per-IP auth rate limiting.
Authenticated POST and v1 SOURCE handlers do not enforce max_sources or exclusive single-writer mountpoint locks.
security_findings.current_lab_mitigation: Single local synthetic source in lab tests.

security_findings.area: Go ingestor HTTP server timeouts & container bind
security_findings.summary: Go ingestor constructs &http.Server with zero ReadHeaderTimeout, ReadTimeout, WriteTimeout, or IdleTimeout.
security_findings.current_lab_mitigation: compose.yml binds host port strictly to 127.0.0.1:8081:8081.

security_findings.area: Infrastructure secret defaults & unauthenticated internal buses
security_findings.summary: compose.yml defaults POSTGRES_PASSWORD to CHANGE_ME; local NATS JetStream and Redis run without authentication or TLS.
security_findings.current_lab_mitigation: All Compose host ports bind strictly to 127.0.0.1.

security_findings.area: Slowloris / per-recv timeout without total header deadline
security_findings.summary: _read_request_head() sets per-recv() timeout (5.0 s) rather than a cumulative monotonic wall-clock deadline across headers.
CasterConfig.allow_unauthenticated_sourcetable defaults to True, exposing mountpoint metadata and bound port.

security_findings.area: Secret fields visible in dataclass repr()
security_findings.summary: CasterConfig.client_credentials, CasterConfig.source_credentials, and ClientConfig.password lack repr=False.
security_findings.current_lab_mitigation: StructuredEventLogger redacts configured secrets; Day 6 caplog test verified zero log leaks.

security_findings.area: Containerization, CI security scanning & dependency governance
security_findings.summary: services/correction-service has no Dockerfile/Compose definition; CI lacks container vulnerability and secret scanning beyond CodeQL/dependency review.
security_findings.current_lab_mitigation: Local package tested via make check; all Compose host binds are 127.0.0.1.

security_findings.area: Incomplete audit logging on 405 and source-push auth/mountpoint failures
security_findings.summary: 405 Method Not Allowed, POST 401/404, and SOURCE bad password/mountpoint rejections do not emit structured audit events.
security_findings.current_lab_mitigation: Client GET 401/404 and connect/disconnect are logged with redaction.

security_findings.summary: fetch_sourcetable() returns (None, '') on malformed response without recording an error in ClientDiagnostics.
security_findings.current_lab_mitigation: Used only for local source-table probes; receive_frames() tracks all errors.

security_findings.area: Stalled subscriber eviction vs drop accounting
security_findings.summary: MountpointBroker drops frames explicitly on subscriber queue overflow rather than evicting chronically stalled TCP subscribers.
security_findings.current_lab_mitigation: Bounded maxsize prevents unbounded memory growth; healthy clients remain unaffected.

security_findings.summary: Eight verified lab security invariants: strict 127.0.0.1 binding, constant-time hmac.compare_digest auth, default TLS verification in Phase 10, non-root containers, immutable NLGCP_DATA_ROOT, atomic client slot reservation, fail-closed RTCM/VRS admission gates, and zero credential leaks in logs.
security_findings.current_lab_mitigation: Regression-tested across 55 Phase 12 + 94 Python Phase 10 + 30 Go Phase 10 tests.
